chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from 'Ammar ibn Marwan, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The completion of Hajj is meeting the Imam.
ai.seo_question: What completes the Hajj according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from Al-Kafi underscores that the spiritual perfection of Hajj is contingent upon Ziyarah (visitation) of the Imam, reflecting the Shi'i emphasis on the Imam as the living guide of the community. This concept elevates the physical act of pilgrimage into a relational encounter with divine authority, a principle deeply rooted in the belief that the Imam is the 'Hujjah' (proof) of God on earth.
